question: Two rods of lengths $L_1$ and $L_2$ are welded together to make a composite rod of length $(L_1 + L_2)$. If the coefficients of linear expansion of the materials of the rods are $\alpha_1$ and $\alpha_2$ respectively, the effective coefficient of linear expansion of the composite rod is
solution:
The total expansion is the sum of the two: $(L_1 + L_2)\alpha\Delta T = L_1\alpha_1\Delta T + L_2\alpha_2\Delta T$:
$$\alpha = \frac{L_1\alpha_1 + L_2\alpha_2}{L_1 + L_2}$$
